text:
Two similar metal containers, P and Q, each contain water at 90°C. Both containers are the
same size and both are sealed.
The water in container P cools more quickly than the water in container Q.
Which statement is correct?
A
P contains more water than Q.
B
P has a shinier surface than Q.
C
P is painted a darker colour than Q.
D
P is surrounded by a vacuum and Q is surrounded by air.

options.label: A
options.text: P contains more water than Q.

options.label: B
options.text: P has a shinier surface than Q.

options.label: C
options.text: P is painted a darker colour than Q.

options.label: D
options.text: P is surrounded by a vacuum and Q is surrounded by air.
